judge_attack_vectors.judge_question: Your 280 test frames come from 6 surgical videos; frames every 8 steps are temporally correlated. Are your confidence intervals inflated by treating frames as i.i.d.?
judge_attack_vectors.defense: We report video-level cluster bootstrap 95% CIs (2,000 resamples at the whole-video level) and paired video-level bootstrap deltas for both verifier precision and student accuracy.

judge_attack_vectors.judge_question: In CholecSeg8k, 'liver' is 100% present, and under SEED=0 'blood' (0/280) and 'cystic_duct' (1/280) have almost no positive frames in the 6 test videos. Doesn't that distort macro accuracy?
judge_attack_vectors.defense: 1) We exclude 100%-present `liver` from all headline metrics (`mean_acc_by_source` uses the 5 remaining labels). 2) We report both the 5-label headline AND the Core-3 balanced test subset (`grasper`, `l_hook`, `gallbladder`, which have 201/280, 92/280, and 194/280 positives on TEST), while explicitly framing `cystic_duct` and `blood` on TEST as false-positive suppression (specificity) benchmarks.

judge_attack_vectors.judge_question: Did your verification threshold or student training leak ground-truth labels or test videos?
judge_attack_vectors.defense: 1) Splits are strictly disjoint at the video level (0 overlapping videos between train/calib/test). 2) `labels_*.jsonl` files carry zero ground-truth fields (`truth` dropped at generation time); GT is joined only inside the post-hoc evaluation step. 3) `upper_bound_calibrated` and `oracle_upper_bound` are isolated and explicitly marked as UPPER BOUNDS ONLY.

judge_attack_vectors.judge_question: Anyone can get high accuracy by abstaining on 90% of frames. What happens to downstream utility when you reject uncertain labels?
judge_attack_vectors.defense: We prove utility two ways: (a) Full risk-coverage curves (AURC, coverage@95%, acc@60%) against single-pass confidence and majority vote; (b) Downstream specialist distillation (`student.py`), where the same DINOv2 linear probe trained ONLY on verified labels is evaluated at 100% coverage on all held-out test frames.

judge_attack_vectors.judge_question: Did the agent actually learn from public surgical sources/video, or did Gemini just rely on pretraining weights?
judge_attack_vectors.defense: We compare `--mode manual` against `--mode blank` (identical model & prompt without the self-written manual) on the held-out test split and audit `manual.json` / `research_notes.md` for source URLs and timestamped video lessons.
